Horizontal marking.title: Solid lines
Horizontal marking.description: They separate flows of opposite directions, mark the edge of the roadway and limit the intersection.

Horizontal marking.title: Intermittent lines
Horizontal marking.description: They allow you to change lanes and help you navigate traffic lanes.

Horizontal marking.title: Yellow markings
Horizontal marking.description: Used for areas where stopping or parking is prohibited.

Horizontal marking.title: Combined lines
Horizontal marking.description: Crossing rules depend on the side from which the driver approaches the line.

Horizontal marking.title: Pedestrian Crossings
Horizontal marking.description: They highlight the crossing point and increase the driver’s attention when approaching pedestrians.

Horizontal marking.title: Stop lines
Horizontal marking.description: Shows the mandatory stopping point before the intersection, traffic light or stop sign.

Horizontal marking.title: Directions by lane
Horizontal marking.description: Arrows and inscriptions indicate in which direction traffic is allowed from each lane.

Horizontal marking.title: Special lanes and stops
Horizontal marking.description: Designate lanes for route transport, cyclists and public transport stops.

Vertical marking.title: Supports and protruding elements
Vertical marking.description: They help to notice in advance the supports of bridges, overpasses and other massive obstacles along the road.

Vertical marking.title: Lower dimensions of structures
Vertical marking.description: Emphasize the lower edge of tunnels, bridges and overpasses, where it is important to control the height of transport.

Vertical marking.title: Fencing in hazardous areas
Vertical marking.description: Used on curves, steep slopes and in places where visual orientation is especially important.

Vertical marking.title: Fencing in regular areas
Vertical marking.description: The side surfaces of road barriers are highlighted where additional visibility is required.

Vertical marking.title: Curbs and guide elements
Vertical marking.description: The contour of safety islands, curbs and guide structures is prompted at night.
